apps.localizedDescription:
The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Terraria offers more than ever - including the brand new 1.4.5 Bigger and Boulder Content! 

Presenting an impressive catalogue of 5,000+ items, 25+ NPCs, and 400+ enemies and blending elements of classic action games with sandbox-style creativity, Terraria is truly a unique adventure!

The latest content update includes: 

NEW 1.4.5 CONTENT:
- Dead Cells crossover content – new weapons, combat accessories and more!
